source.author: cic
source.text: Tota enim philosophorum vita, ut ait idem, commentatio mortis est.
source.text_original: Tota enim philosophorum vita, ut ait idem, commentatio mortis est.
source.text_english: For the entire life of philosophers, as the same man says, is a rehearsal for death.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Annis igitur plurimis sic suam transegit aetatem, ut ante se uetulam cerneret, quam adulescentulam fuisse meminisset, laudans illud Platonicum, qui philosophiam meditationem mortis esse dixisset.
reuse.text_original: Annis igitur plurimis sic suam transegit aetatem, ut ante se uetulam cerneret, quam adulescentulam fuisse meminisset, laudans illud Platonicum, qui philosophiam meditationem mortis esse dixisset.
reuse.text_english: So for very many years she passed her life in such a way that she saw herself as an old woman before she remembered having been a young girl, praising that Platonic saying of the one who had said that philosophy is the contemplation of death.
